meta.name: rollback
meta.description: Prepare and rehearse a recovery path for an intended release. Use when rollback is assumed, untested or previously failed; follow the environment authority for any drill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在上线前演练回滚,让发布出问题时能快速恢复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都提心吊胆,却从没真试过回滚能不能成。
copy.tagline_en: Rehearse the rollback before release so you can recover fast when it breaks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you ship releases but have never actually tested rolling back.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为一次计划中的发布准备并演练回滚路径:先读任务上下文契约与回滚方法,按环境授权方的规定执行演练,并如实报告缺失的能力或未跑的检查。
howto.when: 当回滚只是被假定可行、未测试过,或此前失败过时触发;演练须遵循环境授权方的要求。

say.text: 为这次发布准备一条回滚路径
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约与方法说明

say.text: 按环境授权方的规定演练一次回滚
say.note: 按授权方规则执行演练

say.text: 回滚演练里缺哪些能力,如实告诉我
say.note: 缺失能力会如实报告,不代为宣称

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude prepares and rehearses a recovery path for an intended release: it reads the task context contract and the method, follows the environment authority for any drill, and reports missing capabilities or unrun checks honestly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when rollback is assumed, untested, or previously failed; any drill follows the environment authority's rules.

say_en.text: Prepare a recovery path for this release
say_en.note: Reads the task context contract and method first

say_en.text: Rehearse the rollback per the environment authority
say_en.note: Drill runs under the authority's rules

say_en.text: Tell me honestly what the rollback drill is missing
